bioproductFeedstocks.description: Clean-label legume protein blend optimized for plant-based meat substitutes. Highly sensitive to thermal cross-linking and bitter sulfur volatile formation under high temperatures (>95°C). SCFX texturizes fibers into juicy, micro-cellular chicken-like strands at 65°C.

bioproductFeedstocks.name: Whole Grain Oat Flour & Oat Beta-Glucan Soluble Fiber Matrix
bioproductFeedstocks.description: Heart-healthy dietary fiber dough designed for functional breakfast cereals and salad toppers. High shear and high steam heat in conventional extruders cause beta-glucan depolymerization and loss of blood-glucose regulation efficacy. SCFX preserves 97% of molecular weight.

bioproductFeedstocks.name: Hydrolyzed Marine Collagen Peptides & Wild Blueberry Anthocyanin Slurry
bioproductFeedstocks.description: Ultra-sensitive cosmeceutical food matrix incorporating wild blueberry polyphenol extract and marine collagen. Anthocyanins degrade and brown catastrophically above 70°C. SCFX expansion at 52°C retains vibrant royal purple pigmentation and >96% antioxidant ORAC capacity.

bioproductFeedstocks.name: Cross-Flow Microfiltered Native Whey Isolate (90% WPI) & Probiotic Core

bioproductFeedstocks.description: Premium sports nutrition formulation for high-protein crunchy clusters. Conventional extrusion unfolds beta-lactoglobulin into an insolubilized rubbery mass with chalky mouthfeel. SCFX allows micro-cellular puffing below 62°C, maintaining 98% native solubility.
